crossRefs.note: “If anyone commits a trespass, and sins unwittingly regarding Yahweh’s holy things, then he shall bring his trespass…
“ ‘As is the sin offering, so is the trespass offering; there is one law for them. The priest who makes atonement with…
But if the man has no kinsman to whom restitution may be made for the guilt, the restitution for guilt which is made to…
Yahweh spoke to Aaron, “Behold, I myself have given you the command of my wave offerings, even all the holy things of…
This shall be yours of the most holy things from the fire: every offering of theirs, even every meal offering of…
They feed on the sin of my people, and set their heart on their iniquity.

translations.web: The money for the trespass offerings, and the money for the sin offerings was not brought into Yahweh’s house. It was the priests’.
translations.bsb: The money from the guilt offerings and sin offerings was not brought into the house of the LORD; it belonged to the priests.
translations.kjv: The trespass money and sin money was not brought into the house of the LORD: it was the priests'.
translations.asv: The money for the trespass-offerings, and the money for the sin-offerings, was not brought into the house of Jehovah: it was the priests'.
